prompt:

Title: Virtual Assistant for Cold Calling (B to B) in North America
We are seeking a talented and experienced Virtual Assistant to make cold calls on our behalf to potential clients in North America, with the aim of closing deals for our digitalization and Business Intelligence consultancy. Our company provides advice and support in digitalization on three levels: consulting in digitalization and Business Intelligence, realization of a business intelligence project to create dashboards facilitating decision-making and the organization of business data, and advice and implementation of an organizational solution, protection of intellectual property. As a Virtual Assistant, you will be representing our company and responsible for making cold calls to potential clients in North America, using persuasive language and strong communication skills to explain our services to potential clients and close deals for our digitalization and Business Intelligence consultancy. You will be documenting each call in an Open/Suite CRM system and ensuring confidentiality of all client information while maintaining professional communication at all times. This is a part-time position during a trial period, which will progress to full-time employment with the possibility to switch to full-time for excellent performers. You will be expected to achieve set targets of 3 to 5 qualified appointments per week for closing deals and contributing to the growth of the company. Great organization and attention to detail in maintaining records and following up on leads are key
</job>

text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboard creation, and data cleaning, and I’m very interested in supporting your North America cold calling efforts for your digitalization and Business Intelligence consultancy.

While my background is in analytics rather than direct sales, I understand the importance of clear communication, organized follow-up, and accurate record-keeping when working with potential clients. I’m comfortable handling structured outreach workflows, maintaining detailed notes, and ensuring every interaction is documented carefully and professionally. I also work with confidentiality in mind and understand the importance of representing a company in a polished and trustworthy way.

One relevant project I completed was **Support ticket analytics** for Clipboardly, a productivity software client. I built a support dashboard using **SQL** and **Power BI**, with a cleaned-up tag taxonomy and visibility into response times and backlog by product area. The dashboard helped identify staffing changes, and **first response time went down 27%** after the dashboard’s recommendations were applied.

My strengths with **Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Power BI, data analysis, dashboard design, data cleaning, and data visualization** translate well to this role because I’m used to working with structured information, spotting patterns, and keeping records organized. I can bring that same level of attention to detail to managing call notes, tracking lead status, and supporting your appointment-setting goals.

I understand you are looking for someone who can help qualify prospects, communicate your services clearly, and contribute to the growth of the company during the trial period. I would be glad to bring a reliable, professional, and detail-oriented approach to that work.

Thank you for your consideration. I’d be happy to discuss how I can support your team.
